function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Below is a **complete, end‑to‑end skeleton** for a modern Trucking Transportation Management System (TMS). It covers: | Layer | Technology | Why | |-------|------------|-----| | **Backend** | **FastAPI** (Python) | Fast, async, auto‑docs | | **Database** | **PostgreSQL** + **SQLAlchemy** | ACID, powerful queries | | **ORM** | **SQLModel** | Combines Pydantic + SQLAlchemy | | **Auth** | **OAuth2** + **JWT** | Stateless, secure | | **Task Queue** | **Celery** + **Redis** | Background jobs (route optimization, email, etc.) | | **Message Bus** | **Kafka** | Event‑driven micro‑services | | **Containerization** | **Docker** + **docker‑compose** | Reproducible environments | | **CI/CD** | **GitHub Actions** | Automated tests & deployments | | **Monitoring** | **Prometheus** + **Grafana** | Metrics & dashboards | | **Logging** | **ELK** stack | Centralized logs | | **Frontend** | **React** + **Next.js** | SSR, fast UI | | **API Gateway** | **Traefik** | Routing, TLS termination | | **Infrastructure** | **Terraform** + **AWS** | IaC, scalable | --- ## 1️⃣ Project Structure ``` tms/ ├── backend/ │ ├── app/ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ ├── main.py # FastAPI entry point │ │ ├── config.py # Settings (pydantic) │ │ ├── models/ │ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ │ ├── base.py # BaseModel + SQLModel mixin │ │ │ ├── user.py │ │ │ ├── driver.py │ │ │ ├── truck.py │ │ │ ├── shipment.py │ │ │ └── ... # other domain entities │ │ ├── schemas/ │ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ │ ├── user.py │ │ │ ├── driver.py │ │ │ ├── truck.py │ │ │ ├── shipment.py │ │ │ └── ... # DTOs │ │ ├── crud/ │ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ │ ├── user.py │ │ │ ├── driver.py │ │ │ ├── truck.py │ │ │ ├── shipment.py │ │ │ └── ... # CRUD helpers │ │ ├── routers/ │ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ │ ├── auth.py │ │ │ ├── driver.py │ │ │ ├── truck.py │ │ │ ├── shipment.py │ │ │ └── ... # API endpoints │ │ ├── services/ │ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ │ ├── auth.py │ │ │ ├── driver.py │ │ │ ├── truck.py │ │ │ ├── shipment.py │ │ │ └── ... # business logic │ │ ├── workers/ │ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ │ ├── route_optimizer.py │ │ │ └── ... # Celery tasks │ │ └── utils/ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ ├── db.py │ │ ├── auth.py │ │ └── ... # helpers │ ├── tests/ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ ├── conftest.py │ │ ├── test_user.py │ │ ├── test_driver.py │ │ └── ... # unit & integration tests │ ├── alembic/ # DB migrations │ ├── Dockerfile │ ├── requirements.txt │ └── .env.example ├── frontend/ │ ├── pages/ │ ├── components/ │ ├── public/ │ ├── styles/ │ ├── next.config.js │ ├── Dockerfile │ ├── package.json │ └── .env.example ├── infra/ │ ├── terraform/ │ ├── docker-compose.yml │ └── .env.example ├── .github/ │ └── workflows/ │ └── ci.yml └── README.md ``` --- ## 2️⃣ Backend – FastAPI ### 2.1 `config.py` ```python from pydantic import BaseSettings, PostgresDsn, Field class Settings(BaseSettings): APP_NAME: str = "Trucking TMS" ENVIRONMENT: str = Field("development", env="ENVIRONMENT") DATABASE_URL: PostgresDsn REDIS_URL: str = Field(..., env="REDIS_URL") SECRET_KEY: str = Field(..., env="SECRET_KEY") ALGORITHM: str = "HS256" ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 30 class Config: env_file = ".env" settings = Settings() ``` ### 2.2 `db.py` ```python from sqlmodel import Session, create_engine from .config import settings engine = create_engine(settings.DATABASE_URL, echo=False) def get_session() -> Session: with Session(engine) as session: yield session ``` ### 2.3 `main.py` ```python from fastapi import FastAPI from .routers import auth, driver, truck, shipment from .config import settings app = FastAPI(title=settings.APP_NAME) app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/auth", tags=["auth"]) app.include_router(driver.router, prefix="/drivers", tags=["drivers"]) app.include_router(truck.router, prefix="/trucks", tags=["trucks"]) app.include_router(shipment.router, prefix="/shipments", tags=["shipments"]) @app.on_event("startup") async def startup(): # Create tables if they don't exist from .models.base import engine from sqlmodel import SQLModel SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine) ``` ### 2.4 `models/base.py` ```python from sqlmodel import SQLModel, Field from datetime import datetime class Base(SQLModel): id: int | None = Field(default=None, primary_key=True) created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow) updated_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow) ``` ### 2.5 `models/user.py` ```python from .base import Base from sqlmodel import Field, Relationship from typing import List, Optional from .driver import Driver class User(Base, table=True): username: str = Field(index=True, unique=True) hashed_password: str is_active: bool = Field(default=True) is_superuser: bool = Field(default=False) drivers: List["Driver"] = Relationship(back_populates="owner") ``` ### 2.6 `schemas/user.py` ```python from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr from typing import Optional class UserBase(BaseModel): username: str class UserCreate(UserBase): password: str class UserRead(UserBase): id: int is_active: bool is_superuser: bool class Config: orm_mode = True ``` ### 2.7 `crud/user.py` ```python from sqlmodel import Session, select from ..models.user import User from ..schemas.user import UserCreate from passlib.context import CryptContext pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto") def get_user(db: Session, user_id: int) -> User | None: return db.get(User, user_id) def get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str) -> User | None: statement = select(User).where(User.username == username) return db.exec(statement).first() def create_user(db: Session, user_in: UserCreate) -> User: hashed_password = pwd_context.hash(user_in.password) user = User(username=user_in.username, hashed_password=hashed_password) db.add(user) db.commit() db.refresh(user) return user ``` ### 2.8 `routers/auth.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from ..crud.user import get_user_by_username, create_user from ..schemas.user import UserCreate, UserRead from ..utils.auth import create_access_token, get_current_user from ..config import settings from ..utils.db import get_session router = APIRouter() @router.post("/register", response_model=UserRead) def register(user_in: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_session)): db_user = get_user_by_username(db, user_in.username) if db_user: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Username already registered") user = create_user(db, user_in) return user @router.post("/login") def login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_session)): user = get_user_by_username(db, form_data.username) if not user or not pwd_context.verify(form_data.password, user.hashed_password): raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Incorrect username or password") access_token = create_access_token(data={"sub": user.username}) return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer"} ``` ### 2.9 `utils/auth.py` ```python from datetime import datetime, timedelta from jose import jwt from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from ..config import settings from ..crud.user import get_user_by_username from ..models.user import User from ..utils.db import get_session oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/login") def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None): to_encode = data.copy() expire = datetime.utcnow() + (expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)) to_encode.update({"exp": expire}) encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithm=settings.ALGORITHM) return encoded_jwt def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_session)) -> User: credentials_exception = HTTPException( status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Could not validate credentials", headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}, ) try: payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[settings.ALGORITHM]) username: str = payload.get("sub") if username is None: raise credentials_exception except jwt.JWTError: raise credentials_exception user = get_user_by_username(db, username) if user is None: raise credentials_exception return user ``` --- ## 3️⃣ Route Optimization – Celery Task ### 3.1 `workers/route_optimizer.py` ```python from celery import shared_task import requests from ..config import settings @shared_task def optimize_route(shipment_ids: list[int]): """ Calls an external routing service (e.g., OpenRouteService) to compute optimal routes. """ # Example: fetch shipment locations from DB (pseudo‑code) # shipments = Shipment.get_many(shipment_ids) # coords = [(s.latitude, s.longitude) for s in shipments] # For demo, we just call a dummy endpoint url = "https://api.openrouteservice.org/v2/directions/driving-car" headers = {"Authorization": settings.OPENROUTESERVICE_API_KEY} params = { "start": "8.681495,49.41461", "end": "8.687872,49.420318", "optimize_waypoints": "true", } response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params, timeout=10) response.raise_for_status() data = response.json() # Persist route data back to DB # ... return data ``` ### 3.2 `celery_worker.py` ```python from celery import Celery from .config import settings celery_app = Celery( "tms", broker=settings.REDIS_URL, backend=settings.REDIS_URL, ) celery_app.conf.update( task_serializer="json", result_serializer="json", accept_content=["json"], timezone="UTC", enable_utc=True, ) ``` --- ## 4️⃣ Frontend – Next.js + React ### 4.1 `pages/index.tsx` ```tsx import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import axios from "axios"; export default function Home() { const [drivers, setDrivers] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { axios.get("/api/drivers").then((res) => setDrivers(res.data)); }, []); return (

Drivers

    {drivers.map((d: any) => (
  • {d.name}
    • ))}
); } ``` ### 4.2 `next.config.js` ```js module.exports = { env: { NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000", }, }; ``` --- ## 5️⃣ Docker Compose ```yaml version: "3.9" services: db: image: postgres:15 environment: POSTGRES_USER: tms POSTGRES_PASSWORD: tms POSTGRES_DB: tms volumes: - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data ports: - "5432:5432" redis: image: redis:7 ports: - "6379:6379" backend: build: ./backend command: uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload volumes: - ./backend:/app ports: - "8000:8000" depends_on: - db - redis environment: DATABASE_URL: postgres://tms:tms@db:5432/tms REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0 SECRET_KEY: supersecretkey OPENROUTESERVICE_API_KEY: your_api_key_here worker: build: ./backend command: celery -A backend.celery_worker.celery_app worker --loglevel=info volumes: - ./backend:/app depends_on: - backend - redis frontend: build: ./frontend command: npm run dev volumes: - ./frontend:/app ports: - "3000:3000" environment: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: http://backend:8000 volumes: pgdata: ``` --- ## 6️⃣ CI/CD – GitHub Actions ```yaml name: CI on: push: branches: [main] pull_request: branches: [main] jobs: test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest services: postgres: image: postgres:15 env: POSTGRES_USER: tms POSTGRES_PASSWORD: tms POSTGRES_DB: tms ports: - 5432:5432 options: >- --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5 redis: image: redis:7 ports: - 6379:6379 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Set up Python uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: "3.12" - name: Install dependencies run: | pip install -r backend/requirements.txt pip install -r backend/tests/requirements.txt - name: Run migrations env: DATABASE_URL: postgres://tms:tms@localhost:5432/tms run: | alembic upgrade head - name: Run tests env: DATABASE_URL: postgres://tms:tms@localhost:5432/tms run: | pytest backend/tests ``` --- ## 7️⃣ Monitoring & Logging - **Prometheus** scrape targets: `/metrics` endpoint on FastAPI (use `prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator`). - **Grafana** dashboards for: - API latency - DB query performance - Celery task queue health - **ELK** stack: - Logstash ingest logs from Docker containers - Kibana dashboards for error analysis --- ## 8️⃣ Security Checklist | Item | Implementation | |------|----------------| | **HTTPS** | Traefik TLS termination | | **CORS** | FastAPI `CORSMiddleware` | | **Rate limiting** | Redis + middleware | | **Input validation** | Pydantic schemas | | **SQL injection** | ORM (SQLModel) | | **XSS** | React sanitization | | **CSRF** | SameSite cookies + CSRF tokens | | **Secrets** | Vault / AWS Secrets Manager | | **Audit logs** | Append-only log files + ELK | --- ## 9️⃣ Deployment – Terraform (AWS) ```hcl provider "aws" { region = var.aws_region } resource "aws_ecs_cluster" "tms" { name = "tms-cluster" } resource "aws_ecs_task_definition" "backend" { family = "tms-backend" network_mode = "awsvpc" requires_compatibilities = ["FARGATE"] cpu = "512" memory = "1024" container_definitions = jsonencode([ { name = "backend" image = "${aws_ecr_repository.backend.repository_url}:latest" essential = true portMappings = [ { containerPort = 8000 hostPort = 8000 protocol = "tcp" } ] environment = [ { name = "DATABASE_URL", value = aws_rds_cluster.tms.endpoint } { name = "REDIS_URL", value = aws_elasticache_cluster.tms.cache_nodes[0].address } { name = "SECRET_KEY", value = var.secret_key } ] } ]) } ``` --- ## 10️⃣ Quick Start ```bash # Clone repo git clone https://github.com/yourorg/trucking-tms.git cd trucking-tms # Copy env files cp backend/.env.example backend/.env cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env cp infra/.env.example infra/.env # Build & start containers docker compose up -d # Run migrations docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head # Open UI open http://localhost:3000 ``` --- ## 11️⃣ Next Steps 1. **Add more domain entities** – `Vehicle`, `Maintenance`, `Fuel`, `Invoice`. 2. **Implement real route optimization** – integrate with Google Maps API or open‑source OR‑Tools. 3. **Add WebSocket** – real‑time driver tracking. 4. **Implement multi‑tenant** – tenant isolation in DB. 5. **Add analytics** – KPI dashboards (fuel efficiency, on‑time delivery). --- ### 🎉 Done! Feel free to copy the skeleton into your repo, adjust the environment variables, and start building your own Trucking TMS. Happy coding!
